description: Junior reviewer finds most accessibility issues but misses a focus-trap bug. Good effort for junior level with decent reasoning.

prContext.title: Add modal dialog component
prContext.description: Adds a Modal component for confirmation dialogs.
prContext.instructions: Review for accessibility and React patterns.

groundTruth.description: Focus is not moved into the modal when opened — screen reader users stay on the trigger element. Should focus the dialog or first focusable element.
No focus trap — Tab key cycles to background elements. Should trap focus inside modal while open.
Escape key does not close modal — expected behavior for dialogs. Missing keydown handler.
Body overflow reset uses empty string instead of original value. If parent had overflow: scroll, it is lost.

reviewer_comments.what: Modal should move focus when opened.
reviewer_comments.why: Screen reader users need to know the dialog appeared.

reviewer_comments.what: Consider saving the original overflow value.

implementer_responses.content: Added focus to dialog on open.
Good point but our app never sets overflow on body. Keeping simple.

verdict.summary: Focus and Escape fixes look good. Overflow is acceptable for our app.

issue_identification.rationale: Found 2 of 4 bugs (focus, Escape). Missed focus trap and overflow restoration. Good coverage for junior. Level 3-4.

prioritization.rationale: Accessibility issues flagged as suggestions not blocking. Overflow nit correctly deprioritized. Level 2-3.

revision_evaluation.rationale: Accepted focus and Escape fixes. Caved on overflow pushback without verifying app behavior. Level 2-3.

reasoning_quality.rationale: Concrete user-impact rationale for a11y issues. Level 2-3.

question_formation.rationale: No explicit questions but comments imply awareness of user needs. Level 2-3.

ai_direction.rationale: Suggested focus and Escape handling — actionable. No guidance on focus trap. Level 2-3.
